title: Teleport at end

game.name: Easy Choose The Right Path Obby

script:
-- Teleport script to coordinates 3803, 4, -224
-- Make sure Delta Executor is open and the script is executed correctly.

local player = game.Players.LocalPlayer -- Get the local player
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait() -- Wait for the character to load

-- Teleport function
local function teleportToCoordinates(x, y, z)
    if character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
        character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(x, y, z)
    else
        warn("Character or HumanoidRootPart not found!")
    end
end

-- Teleport to the specified coordinates
teleportToCoordinates(3803, 4, -224)
